CODE
Art. 2.3.58.
Rule for children not in common 
Where there are children who are not in common, only the equal sharing of savings made from the respective incomes of the spouses, albeit unequal, escapes the application of the rules on gifts.
Any matrimonial agreement granting a greater advantage which would result for a spouse from the manner of composition, operation, liquidation or division of the joint patrimony, is considered, with regard to them, as a gift.
